functions.notes: Stopped after 30 gate runs, 10 in a row with no reduction (best 0x330 vs 0x364). Function is an OAM entry copy plus 2x2 fixed-point matrix transform (rotscale mode 0x100/0x300, size tables data_020e9198/data_020e9180 indexed [shape][size]). Closed so far: unsigned guard (bls), signed 9/8-bit x/y extraction (if-form with short locals), shared src->entries load, MULVEC22 as a macro (only single-return statics inline under -inline noauto), x/y copy-back via fields. Open: (1) target keeps loop counter i and the u16 arg spilled at [sp],[sp+4] and has 2 extra spill slots, frame 0x20; ours uses fewer spills (0x18-0x1c) so everything after is register-shifted; (2) target computes -(hw<<12) with lsl+rsb feeding mla (m00*hw + -hwf, then + m10*hh) but mwcc folds any source spelling (minus, Negate inline, named negated local) into mul+sub with a shifted operand; (3) target branches over the dbl subtract (cmp r6 hoisted) where ours predicates it (subne). colorsweep --apply only proposed swapping struct field order (semantically wrong, reverted). Not hand-written asm.
